name: Brutagrafix
summary: Brutagrafix, also known as Nu-Brutalism, is a modern design aesthetic prominent between the late 2010s and early 2020s that drew inspiration from the 1950s post-war concrete-minimalism architecture that diffuses heavy, raw, architectural motifs with playful, bright, digital graphics.
description: Brutagrafix, also known as Nu-Brutalism, is a modern design aesthetic prominent between the late 2010s and early 2020s that drew inspiration from the 1950s post-war concrete-minimalism architecture that diffuses heavy, raw, architectural motifs with playful, bright, digital graphics. It rejects boring, smooth minimalism to make user interfaces, products and websites look loud, bold and real.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Concrete-minimalism, Cooperatism, Boldness
